title: Delta-0 settings activate (Enter / pad A / every touch row-tap) has zero test coverage — and is a no-op on the palette+scale rows as shipped
detail: No test drives effect_settings_adjust; parity activates the delta-independent MOTION row with on_settings_adjust nil. Delta 0 holds in code, so Enter/A/touch-taps change nothing on cycle rows — touch-only players cannot adjust palette or scale. The B2 claim is untested and false end-to-end.
recommended_fix: Map delta 0 to +1 for cycle rows (executor or effect); flip the unit pin to expect advance; add an exec-level test driving Enter/A/tap on palette+scale rows asserting change, wrap, persist; script Left/Right ±1 parity legs.

title: hud_test's zero-scale-guard pin is vacuous — it re-implements the guard instead of calling view_compute
detail: The claimed B6 pin cannot fail: deleting view_compute's guard leaves the test green because the test body copies the guard. Only indirect parity/palcheck construction pins the behavior.
recommended_fix: Call the real view_compute (stub Balance, 1280x720) on a zero-inited View and assert ui_scale == 1.0 afterwards — pin the app's guard, not the test's copy.

title: Modal world-input suppression while the settings panel is open is pinned by no test
evidence:
harness/parity.odin (the scenario scripts — only panel keys/taps while open):
		mouse = frames(
			evs(inp.Key_Press{key = .S}),
			evs(inp.Key_Press{key = .Down}),
			evs(inp.Key_Press{key = .Enter}),
			evs(inp.Key_Press{key = .S}),
		),
...
		expected = expected_of(),

app/input/mouse.odin (the untested gate):
	if inp.panel_open {
		#partial switch keys[i] {
		case .S, .Esc:
			append(out, Intent(Toggle_Settings{}))
...
	phase2_blocked := has_right || (has_left && (ui || tray_hit || placing_eff >= 0)) || inp.panel_open
detail: While open, no world input (P/D/T, draw drag, pad world button) is scripted on any device, so the empty-command assertion passes even if the modal gates were deleted. Suppression regresses silently.
recommended_fix: Add a per-device leg pressing a world input mid-panel (e.g. P or a drag; pad X); assert zero commands and unchanged world state until the panel closes.

title: Still present since round 1: pause-on-open / stays-paused-after-close has zero coverage — parity never wires on_settings
detail: The spec I/O row 'panel opens mid-run → pauses, stays paused after close' executes in no test; grep shows no test references effect_settings. A dropped mode flip ships silently. r1 W6 app-effect residual.
recommended_fix: Wire a parity twin of effect_settings (Run→Paused flip, mirroring parity_right_click_effect) or add an app-level open-from-Run test asserting Paused persists after close.

title: Still present since round 1: the parity matrix never runs under any a11y mode or scale >1.00
evidence:
harness/parity.odin (drive_parity; run_input_parity is identical):
	view: rnd.View
	view.catalogs = cat // the render package reads the catalogs (tray chip count/rects)
...
	pal := rnd.palette_load()
	view.palette = &pal
	rnd.view_compute(&view, 1280, 720, &cat.balance)
detail: Neither proc sets ui_scale, palette mode, or reduced_motion — every scenario runs at ×1.00/Off/full-motion. 'Full input parity holds under every mode' stays construction-argued; chip/row rects move under scale.
recommended_fix: Run the scenario matrix once at ×1.50 (plus one palette mode) — e.g. a scale parameter on run_input_parity driving a second pass with view.ui_scale set after view_compute.

title: Still present since round 1: muted-audio captions contract ('muted ≠ silent') still unpinned
location: app/audio/audio_test.odin (no mute case) + spec-7-3 I/O matrix
evidence:
spec-7-3 I/O matrix:
| Muted audio + alert | 7.2 seam | caption strip still captions (muted ≠ silent) | existing contract, pin it |

app/audio/audio_test.odin: grep -i mute → zero matches (7 tests, none touch mute)
detail: The spec explicitly says 'pin it'; the PR's captions section claims 'captions stay live while muted (the a11y contract)'. No muted-run caption test exists — a regression drops captions for muted players silently.
recommended_fix: One audio_test case: mute the stream, fire crisis + arrival alerts, assert the caption queue/dwell output is identical to the unmuted run.

title: Still present since round 1: a11y demo-verb parse-error legs untested
detail: The five demos cover only happy paths. The error returns — and the 100/125 acceptance branches — execute in no test; a parser regression ships silently. P3.
recommended_fix: A parse_demo unit table: bad mode name, bad pct, missing args → error strings; 'a11y scale 125' accepted; malformed directive rejected.

title: Still present since round 1: palcheck picks the 40-vs-48 threshold by color-value equality, not pair identity
detail: A future mode edit that sets a signal token's value equal to a map token's value silently moves that pair under the looser 40 threshold. P3 fragility in the new oracle.
recommended_fix: Build the pairs with a per-pair is_map flag (token indices), and key the threshold on the flag instead of compared colors.

title: Still present since round 1: malformed palette.json mode-table fallback unpinned — and roofs still fall to opaque black
detail: No test calls palette_load on malformed mode bytes. roofs_set lands before element validation, so a malformed entry yields opaque black roofs — contradicting the spec's base-fallback row.
recommended_fix: Add a palette_load unit leg with poisoned mode JSON asserting base-token retention; validate all four roof elements before setting roofs_set.

title: Still present since round 1: caption strip + settings chip/panel never enter any T2 capture
detail: The scaled caption strip and the settings chip/panel rendering are unpinned by pixels; only their rect math is shared with tested code. Low risk, accepted in r1 — resurfacing for the record. P3.
recommended_fix: Accept, or add a later app-layer capture gate that renders one frame with the panel open at each scale step.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0 80%: settings-adjust execution (the panel's happy path) untested — and dead for delta-0/touch. P1 ≈65%: modal suppression, pause-on-open, ±1 emit legs, ×1.25 golden/hit, under-mode parity, muted captions all unpinned. Overall ≈60%. All three FAIL clauses trip.
recommended_fix: Land the delta-0 exec test (and fix the behavior), the suppression + pause legs, one scaled/mode parity pass, the 1152×648 or ×1.25 leg, and the muted-captions case; re-gate.
